annotations.title: Rename, copy, roll back or delete an automation

description: Changes an existing automation without editing its logic. update sets the name or description; copy makes a custom copy on the same number, switched off, with its own persona, knowledge and remembered values (name defaults to the original’s followed by “(copy)”); rollback moves the automation to an earlier version (to_version is the version number) and, if it is on, it runs that version from then on; delete removes it, and no run starts after it. rollback and delete act only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token they change nothing and return a preview and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, they act.

action.description: update changes the name or description; copy makes a custom copy, switched off; rollback points it back at an earlier version; delete removes it.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number of an automation made before numbers were required, which has none and runs on every number. Accepted once; an automation that has a number keeps it, and another one (or null) is refused. The value it already has, null included, changes nothing.

name.description: The copy’s name. Absent: the original’s, followed by “(copy)”.
